sub: The 1906 classic of the Law of Attraction

headline: Like attracts like.
Thought is a force.
Learn to use it.
paras: More than a century before the Law of Attraction became a worldwide phenomenon, William Walker Atkinson – editor of the magazine New Thought in Chicago – explained it in plain, lively lessons: how thought works like a wave, why fear and worry attract more of the same, and how will, desire and calm attention can change a life.

This beautifully designed annotated edition keeps the complete 1906 text and adds what today’s reader needs to put it into practice, with honest notes on what the science of 1906 got right – and what it did not.
